counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise to 0, leaving all other fields identical. Removes noisy feedback that destabilizes large-dt controller, so pole stays upright.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has large dt 0.0194 near max, seeded sensor_noise 0.0145, initial v -0.307. Noisy angle measurement drives high-gain state feedback at coarse timestep causing large forces >30N that pump energy. Theta diverges from -0.03 rad at step 30 to -0.85 rad at step 34 with omega -12.3 rad/s. Cart velocity reaches 7.5 m/s. Removing sensor_noise alone (counterfactual s2c3d9f5f09) makes run pass with no violations, proving noise+large dt is causal.
vision_note: The pole is nearly upright in steps 31-32 but leans increasingly far to one side in step 33, and in step 34 it is tilted well past the allowed angle with the tip highlighted red as the violating body. The cart stays near the center of the track between the red walls with only small lateral drift, so the failure is pole_upright rather than cart excursion.
